intent.raw: Define, design, and plan publication of the new Augmentor document and rich consultation API to the existing site.
intent.objective: Execute a serial, fail-closed release from exact local rich-consultation bytes to the existing protected production route, preserving owner, credential, rollback, and evidence boundaries.
intent.operator_sentence: Publish the rich Agent API page and consultation family 1.1.0 as one protected release, then prove the exact deployed generation.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The implementation chain is serial across exact owner boundaries. No parallel or delegated runtime is required by this plan.

validation: exact target inventory and baseline binding
bundle closure, full local suites, dry-run and rollback rehearsal
candidate, target, current and rollback generation named
owned release script and production acceptance

steps.name: Freeze exact publication baseline
stop_conditions: block on digest drift, competing production route, missing rollback generation, or attempted product write

steps.name: Close and prove the local candidate
stop_conditions: block on any failed closure, local validation, dry-run, rollback rehearsal, secret handling, or external transport

steps.name: Authorize the exact production effect
stop_conditions: block unless the authorization names candidate digest, production target, current generation, rollback generation and allowed effect

steps.name: Publish and verify the protected generation
stop_conditions: rollback on any start, health, rich-query, byte, auth, restart, topology, CSP or homepage-isolation failure

steps.name: Close the release and preserve residue

outputs.ref: monitoring, human replay, or incident route

stop_conditions: do not claim publication completion after rollback or with missing mandatory production checks

gates.condition: This dispatch validates against the live schema and technique catalog.
Design selection evidence is design-validator-pass and every required output is authored.
AUGPUB-000 through 003 pass with an exact candidate receipt and no external effect.
The exact candidate, target, current generation, rollback generation and one release effect are explicitly authorized.
AUGPUB-004 and 005 prove the current generation or restore the previous generation.
The receipt contains exact evidence, rollback locator, boundaries and residue without secrets.

boundaries.contract: Only the exact seven-file 1.1 consumer bundle crosses as one digest-bound unit.
Local proof hands off an exact candidate; only a later named authorization permits one remote switch.
Return hashes, statuses, generation ids, rollback and residue; never credentials.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke Plan and later Task Session
authority.execution: Task Session within admitted unit; production operator for AUGPUB-004
authority.validation: producer, consumer, browser and production validation owners
authority.evidence: Task Session closeout and deployment receipt owners
authority.promotion: production operator only for the named release generation

state_namespaces.write_policy: generator-owned source and outputs only after Task Session admission
consumer runtime/docs only after exact baseline admission
one immutable release through the owned script after exact authorization

promotion_splits.rule: requires exact external-effect authorization after AUGPUB-003
requires AUGPUB-005 acceptance and AUGPUB-006 closeout

promotion_guardrails: A Plan artifact is not product mutation, deployment, release or production evidence.
Local validation cannot authorize or prove the production switch.
A rollback receipt cannot be reported as publication completion.
The API remains read-only evidence retrieval and does not become a reasoning engine or authority.
No credential may enter source, candidate, command output, observability or receipt artifacts.
